stem: The assigned dry-room destination is unavailable, and no alternate is authorized. What should Technician I do?
choices: Pause the affected transfer and obtain controlled authorization for an alternate destination before moving the material.
Use any open rack that appears suitable and update the destination later.
Leave the material staged unlabeled outside the dry room until space becomes available.
Change the work order after the fact so the actual destination appears authorized.
rationale: A destination change affects identity, location, receiving readiness, and potentially environmental control. If the assigned dry-room location is unavailable and no alternate is authorized, Technician I should pause the transfer and obtain a controlled destination decision. Improvising a rack or rewriting the work order afterward breaks traceability and authority boundaries.
